headline.summary: Capacity hypothesis validated at multi-seed: doubling motor pool capacity (n_motor 1000 -> 2000) lifts 12-word retention from 2/3 GO PARTIAL to 3/3 GO unanimous, with the failing seed seeing the largest lift (71% -> 100% primary).

pillars.metric: A2W mean 58.3% +/- 20.4% (5/6 seeds at >= 50%, 5/6 above chance); single-seed 75% reproduces; per-direction N=67% E=67% S=67% W=33%
